strings.name: Kevin De Bruyne
strings.summary: De Bruyne's vision, through-balls, crosses and long-range shooting made him a major modern playmaker. From Genk, Chelsea, Werder Bremen and Wolfsburg he reached Manchester City, contributing to repeated Premier League titles and the 2023 treble. He helped Belgium finish third at the 2018 World Cup. After joining Napoli in 2025, he continued club and international football.
